data.name: Hills Of Glory 3D
data.detailed_description:
In case of doubt, empty your magazines!

“Kill them all…if you survive of course. It’s time to save Europe and make History. We’ll land in Italy, fight many battles to reach Germany and end this War. We need you to maintain our most critical positions!”

Armed to the teeth


Lose yourself in Hills of Glory 3D, a WW2 reverse tower defense game with stunning 3D graphics. In this war game, defend your bunker against hordes of enemies with the military arsenal at your disposal. Rifle, mortar, flamethrower, air strikes… don’t hold back!

The eye of the Tiger


Bring out the Rambo inside you to survive through 21 missions or the Endless mode. Step into the shoes of a military strategist: analyze the battlefield and destroy tactical points to block your enemies’ path.

Brothers in arms


Prove yourself on the battlefield and be promoted to unlock and collect rewards. Share your scores with your brothers in arms on Facebook!

Leave no one behind


Hills of Glory 3D will please all the tower defense’s fans with funny cartoon animations and humoristic war movies references!

reviews.review:
[h1]One Sentence Summary:[/h1]
Hills of Glory 3D is 95% action and 5% strategy with nice visuals and core gameplay that is unfortunately marred by frustrating controls, lack of polish, and no depth in game design or atmosphere.

[h1]Strengths:[/h1]
+ Core gameplay is fun, arcadey, and somewhat reminiscent of Missile Command

+ Quality of animation, in-game models, and overall artistic direction is nice

+ Ascension through military ranks as you gain experience is a satisfying touch

+ The objective to liberate Europe by clearing countries on the map works well

[h1]Weaknesses:[/h1]
- There is no sense of strategy and every level just becomes an arcadey twitch-fest

- Controls are poorly thought out and scrolling around the badly designed maps is frustrating

- The weapons and upgrades are poorly balanced and are unsatisfying to use

- There is only one background soundtrack which gets annoying rather quickly

- Menu and UI design is poor, which is strange considering the otherwise nice artistic direction

- Enemy soldiers are always tip-toeing to random shooting spots which is rather non-sensical

- A general lack of polish which is unfortunate because with a little more effort this game could have been pretty nice

[h1]Notes:[/h1]
~ I still recommend the game for its core action gameplay mechanics, just don't expect any real strategy, polish, or depth

~ Some visual design elements of the game reminded me of Advance Wars, but unfortunately they didn't give any depth to the game world the way that Advance Wars does
